jobs_results.title: Senior Business Intelligence / Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
• Empresa final|Entorno internacional

About Our Client

Nuestro cliente es un importante grupo de servicios profesionales de unos 10.000 empleados. Están ubicados en Madrid, cerca de Ciudad Lineal y es una compañía que se enorgullece de su enfoque en la innovación y el uso de tecnologías de vanguardia.

Job Description
• El/la analista senior de datos e informes jugará un papel clave en generar valor comercial a través de insights de clientes y operaciones.
• Gestionar las relaciones de los principales stakeholders para comprender sus necesidades y construir/mantener soluciones de datos acordes a las mismas.
• Trabajar con el equipo de tecnología para definir y construir la estructuras de datos necesarias.
• Encontrar nuevas y innovadoras formas de utilizar datos, informes y análisis avanzados para ayudar a los usuarios y mejorar los resultados comerciales.

The Successful Applicant

El/la candidato/a seleccionado deberá cumplir los siguientes requisitos:
• Inglés C1, tu día a día... será en inglés, por lo que sentirte cómodo/a hablando en inglés es esencial.
• Al menos 3-5 años de experiencia como Business Intelligence con clara tendencia hacia la parte de negocio y siendo nexo con el equipo técnico de DATA.
• Capaz de construir relaciones con los interesados del negocio, comprender necesidades subyacentes y planificar e impulsar soluciones de datos
• Impulsar proyectos, gestionar requerimientos, riesgos y plazos de entrega.
• Alta capacidad de resolución de problemas y proactividad.
• Experiencia previa en la parte técnica de DATA y buen dominio con PowerBI
• Además de la anterior herramienta, se valora positivamente dominio en SQL, DAX y ETLs.

What's on Offer
• Salario competitivo con un rango estimado de 40.000 a 60.000€ b/a, a valorar según experiencia previa.
• Seguro médico.
• Ayuda para el transporte.
• Cheques de restaurante.
• Un entorno de trabajo positivo y centrado en el equipo.
• Oportunidades de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional en el sector de servicios profesionales.
• Modalidad de trabajo: híbrido, 3 días en oficina, 2 en casa.
• Oficinas ubicadas cerca de Ciudad Lineal

Contact: Carmen Gomez

Quote job ref: JN-042024-6395406

jobs_results.title: Lansweeper - Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
With a recent funding round from Insight Partners and impressive yearly revenue growth, Lansweeper is rapidly expanding our Global team. We are looking for a Data Analyst in the Spanish office located in Alicante.

Lansweeper is an IT asset management software company helping businesses better understand, manage and protect their IT devices and network. We currently discover and monitor around 100 million connected devices from 25,000+ customers, including Mercedes, FC Barcelona, Michelin, Sony, Carlsberg, Nestlé, IBM, Maersk and Samsung to governments, banks, NGOs, and universities, driven by its 200+ team members in Belgium, Canada, Spain, Italy, Ireland, UK and the USA.

Over 90% of our customers renew their subscriptions every year and we onboard 250 new customers every month. Our high-performance/high-reward culture emphasizes improvement and progress. Under the "work hard, play hard" motto we want employees to grow professionally through ongoing learning and taking on new... challenges. Discover more about Lansweeper impressive growth on this video.

A Day In The Life Of
• Work as a part of the growing team delivering a data-driven organization.
• Work closely with the product team to deliver targeted and effective business intelligence. Create data insights and present them in a digestible and accessible way.
• Help defining key product metrics and track product KPIs.
• Work closely with product and engineering in collecting the right data to produce relevant business insights.
• Help measure and drive adoption and engagement of the product.
• Actively represent best practices for data architecture and business, and collaborate with the other members of the data team to design a data analytics and business warehouse solution.

Job requirements

Are you the new Data Analyst at Lansweeper?

I Am Someone Who
• Has an analytical mindset.
• Is dynamic, committed, hands-on and passionate.
• Communicates fluently.
• Is open minded, eager to learn and embraces change.
• Is a team player willing to go the extra mile.
• Works independently with business stakeholders providing solutions and regular updates.
• Has experience in working in Agile teams.

I Have
• Proven work experience (4+ years) as a Product Data Analyst or similar role.
• Proficient in writing SQL.
• Experience with data analysis languages such as Python, R, …
• Experience with BI tools such as Power BI and Tableau to create reports, visualizations, and interactive dashboards.
• Experience with statistical tools to identify and analyze trends in complex data sets.
• Good communication skills to help deliver insights to diverse stakeholders.

Our offer you can’t refuse
• Flexibility is key! Work efficiently by using our flexible working hours and working from home.
• Work for an international company where you get to travel to meet your colleagues for a great (teambuilding) event at least once a year.
• Collaborate with passionate and driven colleagues every day.
• Accelerate your career: new opportunities are right around the corner.
• We offer a variety of benefits (medical insurance, pension plan, allowances…).

Meet our Recruiter Jenna Bloem

jobs_results.title: Master Data
jobs_results.description:
Estamos seleccionando un Master Data para nuestro departamento de Control de Gestión Industrial.La persona seleccionada se encargará de cargar y mantener los datos maestros actualizados en nuestro ERP, garantizando el proceso y los flujos de información asociados.

Buscamos un perfil que aporte experiencia en implantación de SAP, carga de datos maestros y seguimiento del arranque.

¿Tienes experiencia como Master Data? ¿Te consideras una personas proactiva, comunicativa, organizada y metódica?

Te encargarás de:
• Ejecutar el alta y la gestión de los artículos en el maestro de materiales del ERP.
• Ejecutar el alta de las nuevas listas de materiales.
• Mantener, actualizar y gestionar las listas de materiales, tanto las nuevas como las versiones existentes.
• Asignar y mantener los datos necesarios para el correcto etiquetado y arte final de componentes y palets, relacionda con cada uno de los clientes.

Se trata de una posición estable, ofrecemos incorporación en una empresa en pleno... proceso de expansión y que apuesta por las personas.

Requisitos:
• Valorable formación superior: Lic.Documentación, Ing.Organización Industrial, otras titulaciones afines. Valorable formación postgrado tipo Master SAP.
• Imprescindible aportar experiencia previa como Master Data en empresas sector industrial.
• ERP SAP.
• Nivel EXCEL alto

jobs_results.title: Language Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
TELUS International is looking for Language Data Analysts in Barcelona, Spain to work onsite for a machine learning project! At the moment, we are looking for candidates with fluency in Swedish or Dutch for a temporary vacancy of undefined duration.

Language Data Analysts will analyze data in a given language and identify potential issues. They will also collaborate with international testing teams and engineers to help reproduce issues and test features. Data obtained will be used to train and improve speech recognition and AI systems.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Includes, but is not limited to the following. Other duties may be assigned.
• Linguistic data labelling.
• Analyzing language data in the given language and identifying potential issues and patterns.
• Collaborating with an international testing team and engineers to help reproduce issues and test features.
• Communicating with various departments.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:
• Fluency in Swedish or Dutch .
• Preferred educational... background: linguistics, literature or translation.
• Available to work onsite in Barcelona, Spain.
• Excellent reading, writing and comprehension skills in English; ability to understand and closely follow elaborate guidelines in English.
• In-depth knowledge of native culture and history, staying up to date with day-to-day news and happenings in the target country and regular use of the language required.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to meet project targets.
• Self-motivated and able to work as part of the team or independently.
• Good computer and software skills across different operating systems.
• Strong typing skills.
• Good organizational skills
• Adaptable to changing environments.

WHAT WE OFFER:
• Fixed-term contract with TELUS International
• Meal vouchers
• Referral program with attractive bonuses
• Private medical insurance for employees and relatives
• Great office at a top location
• Positive international working environment (relaxing zones, terrace, kitchen)
• Discounts in gym memberships
• Career development opportunities
• No overtime or weekend work
• Continuous support and learning
• Access to counseling sessions

If this opportunity sounds appealing to you, apply now! Kindly attach your CV in English.
• Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

ABOUT US:

AI Data Solutions

Creating and enhancing the world's data to enable better AI via human intelligence.

TELUS International is looking for Language Data Analysts in Barcelona, Spain to work onsite for a machine learning project! At the moment, we are looking for candidates with fluency in Swedish or Dutch for a temporary vacancy of undefined duration.

Language Data Analysts will analyze data in a given language and identify potential issues. They will also collaborate with international testing teams and engineers to help reproduce issues and test features. Data obtained will be used to train and improve speech recognition and AI systems.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Includes, but is not limited to the following. Other duties may be assigned.
• Linguistic data labelling.
• Analyzing language data in the given language and identifying potential issues and patterns.
• Collaborating with an international testing team and engineers to help reproduce issues and test features.
• Communicating with various departments.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:
• Fluency in Swedish or Dutch .
• Preferred educational... background: linguistics, literature or translation.
• Available to work onsite in Barcelona, Spain.
• Excellent reading, writing and comprehension skills in English; ability to understand and closely follow elaborate guidelines in English.
• In-depth knowledge of native culture and history, staying up to date with day-to-day news and happenings in the target country and regular use of the language required.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to meet project targets.
• Self-motivated and able to work as part of the team or independently.
• Good computer and software skills across different operating systems.
• Strong typing skills.
• Good organizational skills
• Adaptable to changing environments.

WHAT WE OFFER:
• Fixed-term contract with TELUS International
• Meal vouchers
• Referral program with attractive bonuses
• Private medical insurance for employees and relatives
• Great office at a top location
• Positive international working environment (relaxing zones, terrace, kitchen)
• Discounts in gym memberships
• Career development opportunities
• No overtime or weekend work
• Continuous support and learning
• Access to counseling sessions

If this opportunity sounds appealing to you, apply now! Kindly attach your CV in English.
• Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

jobs_results.title: Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
Join our dynamic consulting teams at Globalpraxis and embark on a thrilling journey towards business excellence. We are seeking talented individuals who are passionate about leveraging data science to unlock the full potential of top FMCG businesses. As a Data Scientist, you will be a key part of our consulting teams and fully-embedded to the project role.

Details:
• Start date: ASAP
• Location: Barcelona, Spain

Responsibilities: As an integral part of our project teams, you will collaborate closely with our experts to tackle diverse data challenges and immerse yourself in the daily operations of the project. Your key responsibilities will include, within each project:
• Acquiring, cleansing, and standardizing large-scale datasets.
• Conducting in-depth analyses of complex business scenarios.
• Designing and implementing powerful predictive algorithms for various scenarios.
• Generating actionable insights and user-friendly reports that empower our clients to harness the true... potential of their data.
• Lead other analysts in more junior positions.

Requirements: To thrive in this role, we expect you to have the following qualifications:
• At least 2 years of demonstrable experience in data analytics / data science.
• Master's degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Computer Sciences, Mathematics, Statistics, or Engineering.
• Proficiency in English and Spanish.
• Advanced proficiency in R and/or Python.
• Knowledge and/or experience in PowerBI is considered a plus.
• Experience working with relational databases, including strong SQL query-building skills.

Desired Skills: In addition to the specific qualifications, we value the following skills and attributes:
• Strong analytical skills and a knack for problem-solving.
• Excellent architectural thinking to develop innovative solutions.
• Structured and critical thinking abilities to approach complex challenges.
• Strong interpersonal skills and alignment with our company culture.
• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in a multicultural environment.

Globalpraxis is a renowned international consulting firm known for our blend of academic expertise and dedicated consultants who foster objectivity, creativity, and intellectual rigor. With a strong presence in consumer goods, telecommunications, transportation, pharmaceuticals, and service industries, our strategies in consumer engagement, distribution channels, and customer-centricity have propelled our clients toward global success. With a global reach spanning Europe, Asia, Africa, and the United States, we combine analytical rigor with local insights to become the perfect partner for businesses worldwide.

Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to make a lasting impact on businesses and launch your career forward. Apply now to be a part of our exciting and vibrant team at Globalpraxis
